summary: Nora's event tools are renamed (event_propose, event_revise, event_rsvp, event_set_status, event_search), gain a fuller lifecycle and an optional concurrency check, and every RSVP is now kept rather than overwritten.
details: create_event, update_event, cancel_event, rsvp_event and list_events are now event_propose, event_revise, event_set_status, event_rsvp and event_search; event_search adds optional place, person and interval filters on top of what list_events answered.
An event can now be confirmed, marked happened or lapsed, not only proposed or cancelled; event_set_status moves it between these.
event_revise and event_set_status accept an optional base_revision_id from a prior read; a stale one is refused rather than silently overwriting a change made since.
Every RSVP is now kept as its own row instead of overwriting the last one, so an event's answer history is no longer lost; asking who's coming still answers with only the current one.
limitations: Events do not yet carry a real unit key on rows written before this change; they stay searchable only by room until an operator-run backfill assigns one.
event_search reads across a group's rooms only when a room's unit resolves; otherwise it answers for this room alone, exactly as list_events did.
No tool states a reason or a confidence for an event's fields yet; that starts with the Cognition adaptor.
